turns.question: How do errors propagate through the middleware composition path?
turns.text:
Now I have a complete picture of the error propagation path.I have sufficient evidence across the composition layer (`compose.ts`) and dispatch layer (`hono-base.ts`) to answer confidently.

<ghx-report>
{
  "answer": "Errors propagate in two layers. Inside compose.ts's dispatch(i), each middleware call is wrapped in try/catch: if the thrown value is an Error AND an onError handler was passed to compose(), it's caught, `context.error` is set, `onError(err, context)` runs and its response becomes `res` (isError=true so it still overwrites context.res even if finalized); non-Error throws or cases with no onError are rethrown up the stack. At the top, Hono#dispatch (src/hono-base.ts) wraps `composed(c)` in its own try/catch, routing any escaping error (including the 'Context is not finalized' error at line ~463) to `#handleError`, which calls `this.errorHandler(err,c)` for Error instances (default errorHandler at line 36 special-cases HTTPException via `getResponse()`, else logs and returns 500) and rethrows non-Errors; the single-handler fast path (matchResult[0].length===1) bypasses compose() entirely but uses the same `#handleError` catch/then-catch pattern.",
  "verified": [
    {"summary": "compose()'s dispatch catches handler errors, delegates Error instances to onError, rethrows others", "evidence": "src/compose.ts lines ~48-58 (from turn 1 full read): catch(err){ if(err instanceof Error && onError){ context.error=err; res=await onError(err,context); isError=true } else throw err }"},
    {"summary": "#dispatch wraps composed(c) call, forwarding thrown errors to #handleError", "evidence": "src/hono-base.ts:451-466: const composed=compose(...); try{ context=await composed(c); if(!context.finalized) throw Error(...) }catch(err){ return this.#handleError(err,c) }"},
    {"summary": "#handleError only handles Error instances via this.errorHandler; rethrows everything else", "evidence": "src/hono-base.ts:400-404: #handleError(err,c){ if(err instanceof Error) return this.errorHandler(err,c); throw err }"},
    {"summary": "Default errorHandler special-cases HTTPException-like errors (duck-typed via getResponse), else 500", "evidence": "src/hono-base.ts:36-42"},
    {"summary": "app.onError() sets this.errorHandler, which flows into both compose()'s onError param and #handleError", "evidence": "src/hono-base.ts:272-273 onError=(handler)=>{ this.errorHandler=handler }; used at line 451"},
    {"summary": "Single-handler fast path has its own inline try/catch + promise .catch, also routed through #handleError", "evidence": "src/hono-base.ts:431-450"}

report.answer: Errors propagate in two layers. Inside compose.ts's dispatch(i), each middleware call is wrapped in try/catch: if the thrown value is an Error AND an onError handler was passed to compose(), it's caught, `context.error` is set, `onError(err, context)` runs and its response becomes `res` (isError=true so it still overwrites context.res even if finalized); non-Error throws or cases with no onError are rethrown up the stack. At the top, Hono#dispatch (src/hono-base.ts) wraps `composed(c)` in its own try/catch, routing any escaping error (including the 'Context is not finalized' error at line ~463) to `#handleError`, which calls `this.errorHandler(err,c)` for Error instances (default errorHandler at line 36 special-cases HTTPException via `getResponse()`, else logs and returns 500) and rethrows non-Errors; the single-handler fast path (matchResult[0].length===1) bypasses compose() entirely but uses the same `#handleError` catch/then-catch pattern.

report.answer: Errors propagate in two layers. Inside compose.ts's dispatch(i), each middleware call is wrapped in try/catch: if the thrown value is an Error AND an onError handler was passed to compose(), it's caught, `context.error` is set, `onError(err, context)` runs and its response becomes `res` (isError=true so it still overwrites context.res even if finalized); non-Error throws or cases with no onError are rethrown up the stack. At the top, Hono#dispatch (src/hono-base.ts) wraps `composed(c)` in its own try/catch, routing any escaping error (including the 'Context is not finalized' error at line ~463) to `#handleError`, which calls `this.errorHandler(err,c)` for Error instances (default errorHandler at line 36 special-cases HTTPException via `getResponse()`, else logs and returns 500) and rethrows non-Errors; the single-handler fast path (matchResult[0].length===1) bypasses compose() entirely but uses the same `#handleError` catch/then-catch pattern.
